arxiv-2110-09988.title: Cosmological radiation density with non-standard neutrino-electron interactions
arxiv-2110-09988.creator: Pablo Martínez-Miravé
arxiv-2110-09988.description: Abstract Non-standard interactions (NSI) between neutrinos and electrons can significantly modify the decoupling of neutrinos from the plasma. These interactions have two effects on the overall picture: (i) they alter neutrino oscillations though matter effects and (ii) they modify the scattering and annihilation processes involving neutrinos and electrons and positrons.

arxiv-2306-09367.description: Abstract . We examine the population growth system called Q-processes. This is defined by the Galton-Watson Branching system conditioned on non-extinction of its trajectory in the remote future. In this paper we observe the total progeny up to time n n in the Q-process.

arxiv-2312-17352.title: Coupling of structure and magnetism to spin splitting in hybrid organic-inorganic perovskites
arxiv-2312-17352.creator: Ravi Kashikar 1, D. DeTellem 1, P. S. Ghosh 2, Yixuan Xu 3, S. Ma 3, S. Witanachchi 1, Manh-Huong Phan 1, S. Lisenkov 1, I. Ponomareva 1
arxiv-2312-17352.description: Abstract Hybrid organic-inorganic perovskites are famous for the diversity of their chemical compositions, phases and phase transitions, and associated physical properties. We use a combination of experimental and computational techniques to reveal strong coupling between structure, magnetism, and spin splitting in a representative of the largest family of hybrid organic-inorganic perovskites: the formates.

arxiv-2412-02098.title: Quench dynamics in topologically non-trivial quantum many-body systems
arxiv-2412-02098.creator: Sarika Sasidharan Nair, Giedrius Žlabys, Wen-Bin He, Thomás Fogarty, Thomas Busch
arxiv-2412-02098.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sarika Sasidharan Nair, Giedrius Žlabys, Wen-Bin He, Thomás Fogarty, Thomas Busch. We investigate the non-equilibrium dynamics of a ground state fermionic many-body gas subjected to a quench between parameter regimes of a topologically non-trivial Hamiltonian. By focusing on the role of the chiral edge states inherent to the system, we calculate the many-body overlap and show that the characteristic monotonic decay of the orthogonality catastrophe with increasing system size is notably altered.

arxiv-2412-17184.title: Foundation Model for Lossy Compression of Spatiotemporal Scientific Data
arxiv-2412-17184.creator: Xiao Li, Jaemoon Lee, Anand Rangarajan, and Sanjay Ranka
arxiv-2412-17184.description: Abstract We present a foundation model (FM) for lossy scientific data compression, combining a variational autoencoder (VAE) with a hyper-prior structure and a super-resolution (SR) module. The VAE framework uses hyper-priors to model latent space dependencies, enhancing compression efficiency. The SR module refines low-resolution representations into high-resolution outputs, improving reconstruction quality.

arxiv-2511-07903.title: DynaQuant: Dynamic Mixed-Precision Quantization for Learned Image Compression Thanks: Corresponding author
arxiv-2511-07903.creator: Youneng Bao, Yulong Cheng, Yiping Liu, Yichen Yang, Peng Qin
arxiv-2511-07903.description: Abstract Prevailing quantization techniques in Learned Image Compression (LIC) typically employ a static, uniform bit-width across all layers, failing to adapt to the highly diverse data distributions and sensitivity characteristics inherent in LIC models. This leads to a suboptimal trade-off between performance and efficiency.

pmc-10622198.title: A case of adrenal lymphangioma successfully treated with laparoscopic partial adrenalectomy
pmc-10622198.creator: Heisuke Iijima, Taisho Noda, Kosuke Uchida, Yasuhiro Hakamata, Akira Fujisaki, Shin Imai, Yoshiro Otsuki, Tatsuaki Yoneda
pmc-10622198.description: IntroductionAdrenal lymphangioma is a rare benign tumor of lymphatic origin, usually incidentally detected from various imaging studies taken for an unrelated purpose. We present a case of a right adrenal lymphangioma treated successfully with surgical intervention.Case presentationA 36‐year‐old previously healthy woman was referred to our urology department for a right adrenal mass, discovered during a routine health checkup.

pmc-11388372.title: Towards efficient and accurate prediction of freeway accident severity using two-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation
pmc-11388372.creator: Guanghui Wang, Jinbo Li, Lingfeng Shen, Shuang Ding, Zongqi Shi, Fang Zuo
pmc-11388372.description: Accurately predicting freeway accident severity is crucial for accident prevention, road safety, and emergency rescue services in intelligent freeway systems. However, current research lacks the required precision, hindering the effective implementation of freeway rescue. In this paper, we efficiently address this challenge by categorizing influencing factors into two levels: human and non-human, further subdivided into 6 and 36 categories, respectively.

pmc-11480430.title: The importance of including both sexes in preclinical sleep studies and analyses
pmc-11480430.creator: Grant S Mannino, Tabitha R F Green, Sean M Murphy, Kevin D Donohue, Mark R Opp, Rachel K Rowe
pmc-11480430.description: A significant effort in biomedical sciences has been made to examine relationships between sex and the mechanisms underlying various disease states and behaviors, including sleep. Here, we investigated biological sex differences in sleep using male and female C57BL/6J mice (n = 267).

pmc-12375119.title: Neural correlates of human fear conditioning and sources of variability in 2199 individuals
pmc-12375119.creator: Joaquim Radua, Hannah S. Savage, Enric Vilajosana, Alec Jamieson, Birgit Abler, Fredrik Åhs, Tom Beckers, Narcís Cardoner, Josh M. Cisler, Juliana B. Diniz, Dominik R. Bach, Sigrid Elsenbruch, Steven G. Greening, Daphne J. Holt, Antonia N. Kaczkurkin, Andreas Keil, Merel Kindt, Kathrin Koch, Kevin S
pmc-12375119.description: Pavlovian fear conditioning is a fundamental process in both health and disease. We investigate its neural correlates and sources of variability using harmonized functional magnetic resonance imaging data from 2199 individuals across nine countries, including 1888 healthy individuals and 311 with anxiety-related or depressive disorders.

pmc-12396299.title: Evaluating digital intervention approaches for supporting immigrant women with intimate partner violence experiences: Findings from the It's weWomen plus sequential multiple assignment randomized trial (SMART)
pmc-12396299.creator: Bushra Sabri, Jian Li, Subhash Aryal, Theresa Mata, Sarah M. Murray, Nancy Glass, Jacquelyn C. Campbell
pmc-12396299.description: BackgroundIntimate partner violence (IPV) disproportionately affects immigrant women, who often face barriers to accessing in-person services. Digital interventions offer a promising alternative by providing tailored, remote support.MethodsIn this SMART trial, 1265 foreign-born immigrant women across the U.S. were randomized to a personalized online (n = 660) or standard online safety information (n = 605) intervention.

pmc-12581932.title: Alcohol Promotion via User‐Generated Content on Instagram and TikTok: A Content Analysis
pmc-12581932.creator: Alessandro Crocetti, Nichole Lister, Florentine Martino, Jennifer Browne, Kathryn Backholer, Peter Miller, Emma Jane Pristov, Matthew Dunn
pmc-12581932.description: IntroductionAlcohol‐related user‐generated content (UGC)—created by influencers and peers—appears to play a central role in shaping young people's alcohol‐related attitudes and behaviours. However, the nature and extent to which UGC facilitates the promotion of alcohol remains under‐examined. There is limited evidence on how alcohol companies utilise social media platforms to engage users and incentivise the promotion of their brands and products.

pmc-13028917.title: A Comparative Study of Choline Chloride Deep Eutectic Electrolytes: Towards Sustainable Supercapacitors
pmc-13028917.creator: Raquel San Emeterio, Antía Santiago-Alonso, Juan José Parajó, Ana T. S. C. Brandão, Carlos M. Pereira, Carlos Gracia, Pablo Vallet, Renata Costa, Josefa Salgado
pmc-13028917.description: Over the past few decades, ionic liquids (ILs) have gained attention as electrolytes, although concerns about their environmental persistence and toxicity challenge their status as green solvents. In this framework, choline chloride (ChCl) offers a more sustainable alternative due to its low toxicity, biodegradability, and cost-effectiveness.

pmc-13346431.title: PS-40 - EMERGING AND RE-EMERGING STIS IN GAY, BISEXUAL, AND OTHER MEN WHO HAVE SEX WITH MEN (GBMSM) IN ENGLAND
pmc-13346431.creator: Miss Megan Walsh, Holly Fountain, Katy Sinka
pmc-13346431.description: BackgroundGay, bisexual, and other men who have sex with men (GBMSM) have been disproportionately affected by emerging/re-emerging STIs: lymphogranuloma venereum (LGV), syphilis, and shigella, each of which increased over time to become endemic. Real-time enhanced STI surveillance supports detection, monitoring, and control. Understanding past emergence may help guide responses to new challenges such as mpox.

pmc-13475465.title: Exploring variables leading to major postmarketing label changes in leading regulatory authorities: a retrospective cohort study in Israel
pmc-13475465.creator: Alla Vishkautzan, Michal Hirsch Vexberg, Matitiahu Berkovitch, Shai Ashkenazi, Ilana Weiss, Rami Hershkowitz, Einat Gorelik, Haim Maayan, Denize Ainbinder, Yehudit Steinmetz, Noa Berar Yanay, Orly Schlissel, Katerina Shulman, Muhammad Azem, Nirit Yarom, Neriya Gutgold, Milly Divinsky, Moshe E Gatt,
pmc-13475465.description: AbstractObjectiveThe US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and the European Medicines Agency (EMA) are leading benchmarks for reliance approval pathways, while many regulatory authorities streamline their review processes by referencing these authorities’ evaluations and decisions. Major postmarketing (MPM) modifications, reflecting benefit–risk updates, are often added to approved labels.

pmc-13479528.title: Myeloid MMP14 couples extracellular proteolysis to inflammatory and metabolic remodeling during obesity
pmc-13479528.creator: Long J Shao, Fathima Elizondo, Feng Gao, Elizabeth L Lieu, Bharati Reddi, Maryam Elizondo, Iqbal Mahmud, Kristin Eckel-Mahan, Philipp E Scherer, Xin Ge, Huaizhu Wu, Sean Hartig, Kai Sun
pmc-13479528.description: SUMMARYMacrophages orchestrate tissue remodeling, inflammation, and metabolic dysfunction in obesity, but the role of macrophage-intrinsic extracellular proteolysis in immunometabolic regulation remains unclear. Matrix metalloproteinase-14 (MMP14), a membrane-bound protease, is strongly induced during monocyte-to-macrophage differentiation and further elevated in adipose tissue macrophages from high-fat diet (HFD)-fed mice.

uslaw-usc-t16-s460h.title: 16 U.S.C. § 460h — Costs of surveys or relocation of boundaries
uslaw-usc-t16-s460h.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s460h.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 1 (National Parks, Military Parks, Monuments, And Seashores); Subchapter LXVII (Cottage Site Developments And Uses In Reservoir Areas). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The costs of any surveys or the relocation of boundary markers necessary as an incident of a conveyance or other property transfer under this subchapter shall be borne by the grantee.
